column1: # Domain matrix for coverage row ri (ResourceInput = named resource input, prd.md §0.6; never "runtime integrity").
# Parent stays NOT_READY until every required cell is observed on the same candidate on all six native hosts.
# COVERED_LOCAL = a registered IMPLEMENTED lnx/x86_64 batch asserts exactly this requirement (evidence = batch-id:assertion-label/group).
# The COVERED_LOCAL observations ran on Root7a/SID4fe; the next admitted candidate must re-run them before they count again.
# Unrun, PREPARED, pending, private-probe and partial (weaker-than-required) assertions are never COVERED; PARTIAL notes stay MISSING.
# Presence states: PRESENT (nonempty bytes), EMPTY (present, length 0), ABSENT (explicit row presence 0), MISSING (no row).
# Strict ledger answers only (exec/c/run.c:977-994): MISSING => MISSING_EXPLICIT_RESOURCE rc2; snapshot MISSING falls back (run.c:995-998).
# Classes (exec/c/run.c:1003-1032, compiler.c \0cli/* keys): cli-option, source, inc-quote (\0inc/q/), inc-angle (\0inc/a/), hdr-bundled (\0hdr/),
#   attributes (\0cli/attributes), e3-identity companion (image route), package RES, memory (\0memory/*, -run), library (\0library/*, libunisacc).
# status: COVERED_LOCAL | MISSING | NEEDS_PRODUCT_CHANGE | NEEDS_FOREIGN_HOST | BLOCKED:<reason>
